svg.title: Privacy Tiering, Token Deduplication, and Trace-to-Eval Gate
svg.desc: Four-panel diagram summarizing Claude OTel content modes and HIPAA/ZDR overrides, 0.75 MB asymmetric span truncation, multi-layer token deduplication vs Usage API billing limits, and the three-step trace-to-eval gate with primary evidence caveats.

svg.text: C. Token Deduplication & Best-Effort Ledger Limits

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: 1. One source/request: prefer API SERVER over SDK CLIENT when both exist

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Pick one API tier: messages.create OR model_request (not both)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: Compaction: API adds compaction spans; SDK adds compaction.* attrs

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: 3. input_tokens includes cache; Agents: model_request + outcome_eval

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Dedup retries by (trace_id, span_id); OTLP best-effort & opt-out

svg.text: → Traces are NOT a billing ledger; use Usage API for complete key audits
